items.title: Quick file tools
items.body: Merge or split PDFs, turn pictures into a PDF and resize, convert or compress a picture, all from Tools on Home.

items.title: Restore uploads and folders
items.body: Deleted uploads and folders now wait in Recently deleted for 30 days, as designs do.

items.title: Bring back one page
items.body: In Version history, bring back a single page from an earlier version without losing later work.

items.title: Send your templates
items.body: Send one of your templates as a file. Whoever opens it can add it to their templates.

items.title: Diagrams
items.body: Add a flow chart, a cycle or a mind map from Add, and edit its steps as a list.

items.title: Pointer and pen in Present
items.body: Point at a slide or write on it while you present.
